findings.message:
Task acceptance not fulfilled: the review found that the candidate does not satisfy source issue #6. Change the candidate so it satisfies everything the issue requires; the reviewer's acceptance evidence:
- `withAppRevision` is invoked only inside the VPS proxy branch at `src/worker.ts:141`, so apps served by their own Cloudflare workers never receive the footer.
- `README.md:58-59` explicitly states apps served by their own workers must provide their own footer integration, leaving most ubq.fi apps uncovered.
- `src/worker.ts:183-190` requires upstream `X-App-Revision` and `X-App-Repository` headers, and this change adds no source for those headers, so no existing app renders the footer without additional out-of-repo work.
- The new tests mock those headers in `tests/app-revision.test.ts:9-12`, so they verify the injection logic but not that any deployed app supplies the metadata.

summary: The router-side footer implementation is internally sound and covered by tests, but it does not meet the every app footer requirement: only VPS-proxied HTML 200 responses are rewritten, and only when the app origin supplies new metadata headers.

evidence: `withAppRevision` is invoked only inside the VPS proxy branch at `src/worker.ts:141`, so apps served by their own Cloudflare workers never receive the footer.
`README.md:58-59` explicitly states apps served by their own workers must provide their own footer integration, leaving most ubq.fi apps uncovered.

`src/worker.ts:183-190` requires upstream `X-App-Revision` and `X-App-Repository` headers, and this change adds no source for those headers, so no existing app renders the footer without additional out-of-repo work.
The new tests mock those headers in `tests/app-revision.test.ts:9-12`, so they verify the injection logic but not that any deployed app supplies the metadata.
